item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Hydration. Your day is full, and busy days are when water gets forgotten. Start with a full glass before anything else, then keep a bottle within reach so you never have to decide to drink. Thirst is a late signal, and dehydration quietly dulls focus and mood. Pair sips with moments you already repeat, like each transition between tasks. Your action: drink a full glass of water right now.
